description: Fall detection multi-turn test scenarios - baseline set

scenarios.name: Senior confirms fall clearly
scenarios.description: Senior immediately confirms they have fallen and need help

user_turns.text: Yes, I fell down in the kitchen
Yes please send help

scenarios.name: Senior denies fall - false alarm
scenarios.description: Senior clearly states they are fine, just bumped into furniture

user_turns.text: No no I'm fine, I just bumped into the table
Yes I'm sure, everything is okay, don't worry

scenarios.name: Senior is unsure and confused
scenarios.description: Senior gives unclear responses - should default to fall confirmed per safety guidelines

user_turns.text: I don't know what happened
I'm not sure, maybe
I don't know

scenarios.name: Senior does not respond (silence)
scenarios.description: Senior gives no response multiple times - should confirm fall after 2 empty responses

scenarios.name: Senior says fine but feels unwell
scenarios.description: Senior initially says they're okay but then mentions not feeling good

user_turns.text: I think I'm okay
Actually I don't feel so good, my head hurts

scenarios.name: Movement detected - senior is fine
scenarios.description: Sensors detect movement mid-conversation, senior confirms they are okay and mobile

user_turns.text: I'm not sure what happened
Oh yes I'm fine now, I got up by myself

system_events.message: Update: The home sensors have just detected movement from the senior (source: living room). This is a positive sign that they may be mobile. Please kindly mention this to the senior and check if they are feeling okay.

user_turns.text: Yes yes I'm perfectly fine, it was nothing

scenarios.name: Senior talks about unrelated topics
scenarios.description: Senior avoids the question, talks about other things - should eventually confirm fall due to unclear status

user_turns.text: Oh hello dear, how are you today?
Did you see the weather today? It's beautiful outside
I was just watching television

scenarios.name: Senior initially denies then admits fall
scenarios.description: Senior first says they're fine but then reveals they did fall

user_turns.text: I'm fine don't worry
Well actually I did slip a little bit
Yes I fell, my hip hurts

scenarios.name: Senior reports broken leg
scenarios.description: Senior fell and reports a serious injury - broken leg. Should immediately confirm fall.

user_turns.text: I fell and I think I broke my leg
It hurts so much, I can't move

scenarios.name: Senior is bleeding after fall
scenarios.description: Senior reports bleeding - urgent situation requiring immediate distress confirmation

user_turns.text: I'm bleeding, I hit my head on the floor
There's blood everywhere, please help me

scenarios.name: Senior is disoriented - doesn't know where they are
scenarios.description: Senior is confused about their location, possible sign of head injury or cognitive distress after fall

user_turns.text: I don't know where I am
What is this place? I'm scared

scenarios.name: Senior doesn't recognize the assistant
scenarios.description: Senior doesn't know who is calling them, confusion indicates possible distress

user_turns.text: Who is this? Who are you?
I don't know what you're talking about, leave me alone

scenarios.name: Senior is crying and in pain
scenarios.description: Senior is emotionally distressed and in physical pain after falling

user_turns.text: Please help me, it hurts so much
I can't get up, I'm on the floor crying

scenarios.name: Senior reports can't move at all
scenarios.description: Senior is immobilized on the ground, unable to move any limbs

user_turns.text: I fell and I can't move, I'm stuck on the floor
I can't feel my legs

scenarios.name: Senior is incoherent and mumbling
scenarios.description: Senior's speech is garbled and incoherent, possible stroke or head trauma after fall

user_turns.text: I... the... fell... kitchen...
help... can't... head...
